status: read-only source evidence; no Drafts created

sources.evidence: Atom Declaration has no immediate-property whitelist for Carrier Destination.
Undeclared immediate dependent Properties are forbidden by default; nested fields therefore require declared Carrier Destination and File intermediates.

sources.reusable_semantics: File.Filename is the file name within its containing directory, including extension; direct string value count is one.
File.Path is a locator distinct from Carrier ID and is string-valued; the user decision narrows it to a repository-relative containing directory.

sources.evidence: Markdown is a File Carrier specialization; it introduces no destination fields.
A Markdown Atom Carrier represents an Atom but does not supply Atom destination Properties.
Delivery to a Carrier exists, but no Atom-to-file-destination Property is defined.

equivalent_property_result: No active Core Meta-Model declaration defines Carrier Destination, Destination.File, expected filename, or an Atom-qualified file path/name. File.Filename and File.Path supply compatible leaf meanings only; they do not constitute the requested Atom Properties.
smallest_draft_set: Successor to CA-R-2508 adding Atom.Carrier Destination to Atom's immediate-property inventory.
Declaration of Atom.Carrier Destination with File as its declared immediate child.
Declaration of Atom.Carrier Destination.File with Name and Path as its declared immediate children.
Declaration of Atom.Carrier Destination.File.Name: calculated string, exactly one direct value when Carrier Destination.File occurs; full filename including extension.
Declaration of Atom.Carrier Destination.File.Path: calculated string, exactly one direct value when Carrier Destination.File occurs; repository-relative containing directory.

compact_claim_patterns.atom_inventory_successor: Add a named-child allowance for Carrier Destination to Atom's first authoritative immediate-property inventory; none exists in CA-R-2508 today, so do not manufacture a closed full-inventory list in this change.
compact_claim_patterns.conditional_presence_option: IF (Atom.Carrier Destination{:1}) THEN (Atom.Carrier Destination.File{:1}); IF (Atom.Carrier Destination.File{:1}) THEN (Atom.Carrier Destination.File.Name{:1} AND Atom.Carrier Destination.File.Path{:1})
compact_claim_patterns.mandatory_presence_option: Atom.Carrier Destination{:1}:[]{:0}; Atom.Carrier Destination.File{:1}:[]{:0}; Atom.Carrier Destination.File.Name{:1}: [string]{:1}; Atom.Carrier Destination.File.Path{:1}: [string]{:1}
compact_claim_patterns.calculation_boundary: Existing CFEL sources provide no destination-calculation expression. State calculated/derived in the two leaf declarations without inventing a filename or directory formula.

unresolved_question: The evidence and user decision fix leaf meanings and calculation, but do not state whether every Atom must have Carrier Destination/File or whether the container is optional and present only when an Atom has a file destination. This determines the occurrence cardinality of Atom.Carrier Destination and Atom.Carrier Destination.File; leaf value count can be one when their parent occurs.
